name: ARTEMIOS BUKKURAT ROUGH 540 RED EDP 100ML
description: A bold, charismatic fragrance with radiant opening notes, rich creamy nuances, and a warm amber-woody finish. Made for those who want a confident, memorable scent for evenings, celebrations, and special occasions. Eau de Parfum, 100 ml. Verify authenticity and stock before listing.

name: Classico Luxury Gold Chronograph Watch
description: Make a statement with the Clasico Luxury Gold Chronograph Watch. Its polished gold-tone finish, stainless steel link bracelet, elegant champagne-toned dial with Roman numeral styling, multi-dial chronograph-inspired design, and date window create a sophisticated look. A versatile accessory for business outfits, special occasions, and everyday luxury.

name: Trendy Flat-Top Oversized Square Sunglasses
description: Make a statement with oversized, flat-top square sunglasses featuring a bold, contemporary silhouette. A versatile unisex accessory for everyday outfits, travel, and outdoor styling. Check the lens UV-protection rating with your supplier before advertising protective features.

name: Classic Men's Leather-Style Belt
description: Complete your look with a classic men's belt featuring a clean finish and versatile buckle design. Easy to style with jeans, chinos, and formal trousers. A practical everyday accessory for work, events, and casual wear. Confirm the actual belt material, available lengths, and buckle finish before publishing.

name: Logitech G304 LIGHTSPEED Wireless Mouse
description: Experience responsive wireless gaming with the Logitech G304/G305 LIGHTSPEED Wireless Gaming Mouse. Featuring LIGHTSPEED wireless technology, the HERO optical sensor, six programmable buttons, and onboard memory, it delivers precise tracking and reliable performance in a lightweight design. Powered by a single AA battery, with battery life depending on usage and settings. A great choice for gaming, productivity, and everyday use.

name: BESTWIN 6615 Luxury Quartz Watch
description: Upgrade your wrist style with the BESTWIN 6615 Luxury Quartz Watch. It features a distinctive shield-shaped geometric case, polished gold-tone plating, a stainless steel link bracelet, and a blue dial with a sporty numerical gauge design. Powered by reliable quartz movement and rated 30M / 3BAR water resistance for everyday splashes. A standout accessory for casual wear, office outfits, or gifting.

name: Afnan 9 Series Discovery Kit
description: Discover the Afnan 9 Series with this five-piece miniature fragrance set. It includes five 2ml vials featuring 9AM, 9AM Femme, 9PM, 9PM Femme, and 9AM Dive. Explore a variety of fresh, floral, fruity, aquatic, citrus, and woody scent profiles in a compact set suitable for sampling, travel, or gifting.

name: P9/P90 Wireless Bluetooth Headphones
description: Enjoy your music wirelessly with the P9/P90 Over-Ear Bluetooth Headphones. Designed with cushioned ear cups and an adjustable headband, these lightweight headphones offer a comfortable fit for everyday listening. Features include Bluetooth connectivity, an AUX input, TF/Micro-SD card support, FM radio, a built-in microphone for hands-free calls, and convenient controls for music playback and volume. The rechargeable battery provides approximately 10 hours of playback, depending on usage. A budget-friendly choice for music, calls, and everyday use.
